2026-07-31.patch_summary: This patch series converts the iomap code to use an in-iter model for iomap_next(), which is a more efficient and scalable approach. The first patch addresses a bug where the folio batch was not being released in certain error scenarios, ensuring that resources are properly cleaned up even when errors occur during I/O operations. The rest of the patches make various changes to support the new in-iter model, including updating functions like iomap_iter() and iomap_next(). This change is expected to improve performance and reduce memory usage for applications using iomap.
